release_notes:
1. Added Meta Advanced Matching user_data mapping with SHA-256 hashed parameters (em, ph, fn, ln, ct, st, zp, country).
2. Reclassified Meta view_cart event mapping to Custom (custom_event_name: 'ViewCart').
3. Pre-hydrated metaUserData across storefront sessions.
4. Strictly omitted external_id and cookies per privacy specification.
